# insertSchema

<link-summary>Stores a schema on a sheet and applies what it describes.</link-summary>

<web-summary>insertSchema() — Stores a schema on a sheet and applies what it describes. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function insertSchema(
  sheet: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet,
  schema: SheetSchema
): GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet;
```

The schema is written into the sheet's developer metadata, so it travels with the sheet — a copy of the spreadsheet carries it, and `getSchema` finds it again without reading a single cell.

The description is also put into effect: the header row is written and the columns get the formatting and the validation their types imply.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                 | Description                                                   |
| :-------- | :----------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `sheet`   | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet` | The sheet to work on.                                         |
| `schema`  | `SheetSchema`                        | The schema: its `version`, the `headerRow` and the `columns`. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet` — the same sheet.

## Throws

| Exception               | Condition                          |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `InvalidSheetException` | the first argument is not a sheet. |

## Examples

### Declaring a schema

```javascript
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

insertSchema(sheet, {
  version: 1,
  headerRow: 1,
  columns: [
    { name: "id", type: "number" },
    { name: "email", type: "string" }
  ]
});
```
